title: Asian Games: Jeus Yape named PH flag bearer for closing ceremony
summary: NAGOYA—Jeus Gabriel Derick Yape, taekwondo gold medalist, will bear the flag for a proud Team Philippines during the parade of athletes in Sunday’s closing ceremony of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games…

blocks.text: NAGOYA—Jeus Gabriel Derick Yape, taekwondo gold medalist, will bear the flag for a proud Team Philippines during the parade of athletes in Sunday’s closing ceremony of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. “He’s deserving [of] that honor,” said Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) president Abraham Tolentino on the eve of the closing ceremony set for 5 p.m. (Manila time) also at Nagoya City Mizuho Park Athletics Stadium, where the hosts opened the games two weeks ago.
